### Set Apart for the Gospel
Author: John UpChurch
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/set-apart-for-the-gospel-crosswalk-the-devotional-nov-10-2010-11639369.html
Passage: Romans 1:1
Points:
- Personal introversion and fear often serve as convenient excuses to avoid sharing Christ with others.
- A sudden encounter with a missionary revealed the sharp contrast between active obedience and comfortable passivity.
- Being set apart for the gospel means believers are called to actively testify to God's work.
- Recognizing spiritual deadness and apathy is a vital step toward living out God's commission.

### Good News for a Broken World
Author: PowerPoint Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/powerpoint/power-point-january-26-2005-1308621.html
Passage: Romans 1:5-6
Points:
- God's message in Romans addresses broken times and remains just as relevant today.
- The gospel holds the power to redeem and transform even deeply troubled and sinful lives.
- Augustine’s life was completely changed after hearing God's prompt and reading the book of Romans.
- Committing to study this profound letter requires thoughtful reflection and yields deep spiritual blessings.
